baselines.name: CDR
baselines.description: Critical Design Review — design released for build.

baselines.name: TRR
baselines.description: Test Readiness Review — ready for the flight-test campaign.

system_states.name: Preflight
system_states.description: On the ground before engine start: walkaround, checklists, external power available.

system_states.name: Taxi
system_states.description: Under own power on the ground, on nosewheel steering and brakes.

system_states.name: Takeoff
system_states.description: Full-power roll through the initial climb to 50 ft, flaps at the takeoff setting.

system_states.name: Climb
system_states.description: Best-rate or cruise climb to altitude at full throttle.

system_states.name: Cruise
system_states.description: Level flight at cruise power with the mixture leaned, navigating en route.

system_states.name: Descent
system_states.description: Powered descent from cruise altitude toward the destination.

system_states.name: Approach
system_states.description: Configured for landing with flaps extended, on a published or visual approach.

system_states.name: Landing
system_states.description: Touchdown through rollout to taxi speed.

system_states.name: Emergency
system_states.description: Abnormal or emergency operation: engine failure, fire, or loss of electrical power.
